comments.text: Please write me an "about us" section for my website for my pest control business Pest In Class Exterminating, located in Johnson City, TN. We are experienced professionals who started an independent pest and termite control company, with our primary focus being quality work and customer service. We worked at other pest control companies for years and decided we could do better work with better customer service at competitive prices We use the best equipment and products, and won't sacrifice quality to be cheap, but we can offer lower prices than many companies charge to do shoddy work or use cheap products. We are homeowners and treat our customers' homes the way we want ours treated. We care about our customers and their homes and families.  We do residential and commercial pest control.
